clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, High Priest Rohan directs human acolytes visiting Khaz Modan to seek their own teachings in Stormwind. The journey brings them to the Cathedral of Light, where human priests learn the traditions of their people.

High Priest Rohan welcomes a human priest seeking deeper spiritual teaching in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward. Dwarven and human priests both serve the Holy Light, yet each people has its own rites, disciplines, and prayers of defense. Rohan keeps Ironforge’s teachings for his own clergy and sends human priests back to Elwynn, where they can learn the traditions of humankind.

After reaching Stormwind City, the acolyte finds High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light. Laurena is relieved to see Rohan’s guidance reach the traveler, and welcomes them as their powers begin to grow. At the Cathedral, human priests can continue learning the spiritual practices of Stormwind and prepare to wield the Holy Light against the threats around the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As much as I'd like to show you our own special teachings of the Light, it is not our place. Your place is back in Stormwind with your own kind, friend... For now. Believe me, I mean no offense. When you return to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light you'll understand what I'm talking about--the time has come for your race to prepare you for the future; to separate yourself from others that follow a similar path.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have wonderful timing, friend. I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people.
Are you ready? Ready for more training I mean. You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
